info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Banking Enterprise Services Internal Audit By Internal Audit Id-v5-spec
info.description: The Internal Audit Detail Retrieval API allows users to access comprehensive information about specific internal audits within the banking enterprise services. By using the internal audit ID as a parameter, consumers can retrieve detailed data regarding audit findings, recommendations, and associated documentation. This endpoint is particularly useful for compliance officers, auditors, and risk management teams who require insights into audit activities for analysis and reporting purposes. It enables efficient tracking and management of internal audit processes within the financial institution.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a specific internal audit resource.
